summary: Comtech Telecommunications Corp. (filer/seller) entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement to sell its satellite and space communications business to Wavestream Corporation (an affiliate of Gilat Satellite Networks). The base purchase price is $157.5 million in cash, with a $10 million advance payment made upon signing. The board approved the transaction and determined it is in the best interests of the company and stockholders; no stockholder approval is required. Closing is subject to customary conditions including accuracy of representations and warranties. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing timeline; risk-arb focuses on conditions to closing.
